name: Pauillac

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Malbec sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

keyfacts: Pauillac includes three of the five premier cru châteaux of Bordeaux: Latour, Lafite Rothschild and Mouton Rothschild.
It sits on the Left Bank of the Gironde within the Haut-Médoc, between St-Julien to the south and St-Estèphe to the north.
The soil is gravelly, and the forest to the west shelters the vines from the Atlantic winds.
Cabernet Sauvignon is the predominant grape, always blended with other grapes such as Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot, Malbec and Carmenère.
The style has been described as stark, with blackcurrant fruit and pencil-shavings and cigar-box notes.

blurb.text: A Haut-Médoc commune in Bordeaux for red wine from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and other Bordeaux grapes. It has three of the five premier cru châteaux: Latour, Lafite Rothschild and Mouton Rothschild.
